errors.text_span: изразен като процент от общия дял
errors.evidence: The phrase 'expressed as a percentage of the total share' is redundant and slightly awkward, as the y-axis label 'относителен дял %' already conveys this information.
The x-axis on the chart visually extends to the year 2020, not 2018.

errors.text_span: Етикетите, които представляват година, са разположени на интервали от една година.
errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are placed at five-year intervals (2000, 2005, 2010, etc.), not one-year intervals.

errors.text_span: Първата линия, представена с тъмно черна плътна линия, показва динамиката на относителния дял на наетите лица в ЕК.
errors.evidence: This incorrectly maps the line style to the entity. The solid black line represents Bulgaria (България), whereas the EC (ЕК) is represented by a dashed line.

The description claims the line for EC starts at 10%. In the chart, the EC line (dashed) starts at approximately 5%, and the line style mentioned (solid black, for Bulgaria) starts at approximately 2%. The 10% value is incorrect for either.

errors.text_span: достига около 20% през 2010 г., след което намалява до около 15% през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the trend and values for the EC line is completely wrong. The EC line remains around 4-5% through 2010 and ends around 6% in 2018. The described values do not match any single line on the chart correctly.
The legend label is 'ОИСР' (OECD), not 'ОИС'. This is a minor typo.
The description, referring to the USA line, states it starts at 5%. The chart shows the solid gray line for the USA starting at approximately 13%.

errors.text_span: достига около 8% през 2010 г. и намалява до около 6% през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the trend for the USA line is incorrect. The chart shows the USA line increasing from ~13% to ~18% in 2010 and continuing to increase to ~20% by 2018, not decreasing.

errors.text_span: Четвъртата линия, представена с тъмно сива пунктирана линия, показва динамиката на относителния дял на наетите лица в Япония.
errors.evidence: This incorrectly maps the line style to the entity. Japan (Япония) is represented by a dash-dot line, not a 'dark gray dotted line'.
The description for Japan's line states it starts at 12%. The chart shows the dash-dot line for Japan starting at approximately 22.5%.

errors.text_span: достига около 15% през 2010 г. и намалява до около 10% през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the trend for Japan's line is incorrect. The chart shows the line is at ~20% in 2010 and increases to ~24% by 2018, not decreasing to 10%.

errors.text_span: Петата линия, представена с тъмно сива прекъсната линия, показва динамиката на относителния дял на наетите лица в България.
errors.evidence: This incorrectly maps the line style to the entity. Bulgaria (България) is represented by a solid black line, not a 'dark gray dashed line'.
